title: Doctoral student in robotic manipulation of deformable objects
about: Doctoral position in Computer Science at KTH School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science within GEOMANIP, an ERC Starting Grant project on robotic manipulation of deformable objects using their geometric structure and physics-inspired neural representations.
requirements: Second-cycle degree (e.g. master's) or equivalent, such as at least 240 credits including at least 60 second-cycle credits
